title: Head of Product - AI LAB
description:
Head of Product \- AI LAB \| DatacomOur Why
Datacom works with organisations and communities across Australia and New Zealand to make a difference in people's lives and help organisations use the power of tech to make it all happen.


About the Role
We're looking for a **Head of Product** for our **AI LAB** who will work closely with the **Head of the AI LAB** and who is equal parts product genius, builder, and relationship wrangler. This is not a role for someone who wants to make pretty widgets and get stuck in a triple diamond design mode. This is a senior, visible, and genuinely challenging role at the heart of one of ANZ's largest technology companies.


You'll be the person who makes AI real at Datacom — for our clients, our teams, and our business. That means bringing people with you, building products that actually sell, and knowing enough about the technology to call a bad idea what it is.


If you thrive in complexity, love people as much as you love technology, and want to build something that matters — read on.


What You'll Do
Product \& Go\-To\-Market — Build Things That Actually Sell
There's no shortage of AI Ideas at Datacom. What we need is someone who can take the best of those ideas and turn them into products that win in the market — products that our own teams want to put into projects for our external customers as well as for our internal work.

**Building Commercial AI Products**

* Lead the development of Datacom's AI product portfolio — from the first whiteboard session through to commercial launch and iteration
* Work closely with Product, Engineering, and Design to shape offerings that are genuinely differentiated — not just features dressed up as products
* Define clear value propositions that resonate with buyers — focused on outcomes, not technology for technology's sake
* Build the business case rigour that gives the organisation confidence to invest — and the commercial model that makes it worth investing in

**Winning in the Market**

* Deeply understand the ANZ AI market — where it is now, where it's going, and where Datacom has a genuine right to win
* Shape go\-to\-market strategies that are realistic, targeted, and built on customer insight rather than internal assumption
* Identify the verticals — Government, Health, Financial Services, Retail — where Datacom's AI products will land hardest and fastest
* Stay close to the competitive landscape and ensure Datacom's positioning is sharp, honest, and compelling

**Making Datacom Teams Love What You Build**

* Partner closely with our Teams to ensure AI products are easy to understand, easy to position, and easy to sell
* Create the collateral, the narratives, and the proof points that gives teams genuine confidence in the field
* Be accessible — the kind of product leader who shows up to client conversations, supports bids, and helps close deals
* Gather post\-sale and post\-launch feedback relentlessly — and use it to make things better


AI Technology — Know Enough to Matter
You don't need to be the best data scientist in the room. But you do need to be the person who knows when something is genuinely promising and when someone is selling you a dream. In this role, you'll be surrounded by people who live and breathe AI technology — and by senior stakeholders who will expect you to hold your own in every conversation.

**Technology Credibility**

* Maintain a deep enough understanding of AI/ML, LLMs, foundation models, and agentic systems to make sound technology judgements
* Know how to spot a bad idea — whether it's an overhyped vendor pitch, an architecture that won't scale, or an automation play that solves the wrong problem
* Engage authentically with Datacom's technical AI teams — earning their respect not through authority, but through genuine understanding and intellectual curiosity
* Be the person who asks the right questions in a technical discussion and knows what to do with the answers

**Agentic AI \& Automation**

* Understand the shift happening right now toward agentic AI — multi\-agent systems, autonomous workflows, and AI that doesn't just respond but acts
* Drive Datacom's capability in intelligent automation — including document processing, workflow automation, conversational AI, and process intelligence
* Oversee the integration of LLMs, RAG pipelines, and agentic frameworks (AutoGen, LangChain, CrewAI) into Datacom products and client solutions
* Ensure Datacom's AI technology choices are sound, scalable, secure, and commercially sensible

**Staying Current — For Real**

* This is a field that moves fast. Really fast. You'll need to invest the time to stay genuinely current — not just across headlines, but across the technology, the vendors, the research, and the use cases
* Be the person in the room who has already read the paper, tried the tool, and formed a view — not the one catching up
* Build a culture of continuous AI learning across Datacom — because your credibility as Head of AI LAB depends partly on the capability of the team and organisation around you


What You'll Bring* Senior leadership experience in AI, technology, or a related field — with the scars to prove it
* Extensive Product Knowledge in a corporate or enterprise scaled environment \- it is fine to have come through an entrepreneurial pathway BUT we need you to have that enterprise product understanding and experience in tandem.
* **A natural relationship builder** — someone who can work a room, navigate resistance, and build trust across every level of a large organisation
* **Real commercial instincts** — you understand what makes a product succeed, how to take it to market, and what sales teams need to win
* **Genuine technical credibility in AI** — not necessarily the deepest technical expert, but someone who has done the work to understand the technology and keeps doing it
* Comfort presenting and influencing at General Manager, Executive, and Leader level — clear, confident, and able to simplify without dumbing down
* Experience in complex, matrixed organisations where you've had to lead through influence rather than authority
* A bias for action — someone who moves things forward, makes decisions with imperfect information, and learns fast


Why Datacom?
At Datacom we value our people and provide a collaborative environment that supports career development and growth.


We offer:

* Flexible \& hybrid working arrangements
* Competitive salary \+ company benefits
* A genuinely senior platform to shape AI across one of ANZ's largest tech companies
* The complexity, scale, and ambiguity that makes a role like this worth doing
* A diverse and inclusive culture where different perspectives are not just welcomed — they're needed
* Real career development and the support to keep growing

 Our platform integrates with systems like Salesforce, analyzing thousands of in\-person sales conversations to surface insights, automate workflows, and drive better outcomes across the org. Think
 *Iron Man’s* 
 Jarvis for sales — proactive, personalized, and built directly into the tools teams already use.
   

  

 Siro has raised $75M and is backed by world\-class investors like Index, Fika, CRV, and SignalFire. We are trusted by leading home\-improvement, retail, hospitality, and automotive brands, and powered by a lean team from Meta, McKinsey, Doordash, and Uber.
   

  

 We’re building the future of human\-AI collaboration in sales — and we’re just getting started.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're looking for a pioneering Data Scientist to help own the analytics and data layer across the company.
   

  

 You'll work across the full spectrum defining metrics, building dashboards, designing experiments, developing LLM\-powered extraction pipelines, and presenting findings directly to customers. This isn't a role where you'll inherit a mature data stack and optimize at the margins. You'll be shaping how Siro understands its own product, how customers understand their sales teams, and how our AI features get measured and improved.
   

  

 As part of a small data team, you'll have real ownership over what you build and genuine influence over what gets built next. The role spans business intelligence, applied AI, and customer\-facing analysis often in the same week.
   

  

 What you’ll do
   

  

 AI Feature Development \& Evaluation
   

  

* Prototype and design new AI\-powered features from initial concept through prompt engineering, pipeline architecture, and validation bridging the gap between what's possible with LLMs and what's useful for customers
* Develop evaluation frameworks to measure the quality and reliability of Siro's AI features extraction accuracy, agentic workflow performance, and answer quality
* Design and maintain benchmarks that track AI performance over time, catching regressions before customers do
* Partner with Engineering to translate evaluation results into concrete improvements, closing the loop between measurement and product quality


 Product Analytics \& Business Intelligence
   

  

* Define and standardize key product metrics adoption, engagement, reliability ensuring numbers mean the same thing regardless of who's looking or where they're looking
* Build and maintain dashboards for both internal teams (Product, Sales, Customer Success) and external customers, covering usage patterns, feature adoption, and product health
* Design data models and enablement tooling that let non\-technical stakeholders self\-serve, and build custom reports and analyses when they can't
* Own data quality and serve as the internal authority on Siro's data establish standards and monitoring, work with Engineering to fix issues at the source, and be the person teams come to when they need to understand what the numbers actually say


 Customer Insights \& Experimentation
   

  

* Combine traditional quantitative methods with LLM\-based analysis across structured and unstructured data to surface actionable insights for customer organizations what's working in their sales process, what isn't, and where the biggest opportunities are
* Design experimental frameworks and ROI analyses for pilot customers, balancing statistical rigor with business pragmatism to prove Siro's impact
* Develop novel extraction and analysis pipelines that deepen what Siro can learn from conversation data, making our insights more differentiated and our dataset more competitively valuable


**Qualifications**
* 2\+ years of experience in data science, analytics, ML/AI, or related field
* Strong foundation in statistics and experimental design
* Strong SQL and Python skills, including experience building and maintaining data pipelines
* Experience with BI tooling and dashboard development
* Experience working with structured and unstructured data
* Comfort communicating data to non\-technical and external audiences
* Experience working with LLMs beyond surface\-level usage — prompt engineering, building with LLM APIs, or evaluating model outputs


 Our Tech Stack
   

  

 Core Tools
   

  

* Data Infrastructure: BigQuery, PostgreSQL, GCP
* BI \& Analytics: Mixpanel, Sigma (or similar BI tool experience with embedded analytics is a plus)
* Languages: Python, SQL
* AI Tooling: LangChain, Google ADK
* Data Science \& ML: pandas, scikit\-learn, scipy, matplotlib/seaborn
* Version Control: Git


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Experience with Node.js/TypeScript
* Background in conversation AI or natural language processing


 Who You Are
   

  

* Comfortable with broad ownership — you'd rather own a problem end\-to\-end than specialize in one narrow slice
* Equally at ease writing SQL, designing an experiment, and presenting findings to a customer's VP of Sales
* Opinionated about data quality but pragmatic about what "good enough" looks like when speed matters
* Genuinely curious about sales as a domain, not just data as a discipline
* Self\-directed learner who stays close to the cutting edge of AI

 **Algorithms Scientist**

You’ll collaborate closely with Engineering, Product, Data Science, and Sales to translate ambiguous business and advertiser needs into rigorous algorithmic solutions that improve ad performance, enhance marketplace efficiency, and drive meaningful revenue growth.

 Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams work in the office Monday through Thursday. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor.  Key Responsibilities
 * **Technical Subject Matter Expertise:**

Maintain defensible data records that satisfy chain\-of\-custody and traceability requirements. Ensure data integrity from acquisition through delivery to downstream consumers.
* **Database Architecture \& Optimization:** 
  Architect and optimize database schemas for performance, scalability, and ease of access. Evaluate and recommend appropriate database technologies (SQL, NoSQL, time\-series) based on data volume, query patterns, and reporting

 Qualifications and Experience

description:
**Position:** Geophysicist


**Location:** Waterloo and/or Toronto, ON (on\-site)


**Employment** **Type:** Full\-Time


**Company:** Canadian Strategic Missions Corporation (CSMC)

  


**About CSMC**



The Canadian Strategic Missions Corporation (CSMC) is a space and defense company focused on developing technologies to address humanity's key needs. Led by a team with a mix of entrepreneurial and institutional experience at the highest level, we are a bleeding\-edge company working at the intersection of nuclear energy, quantum technology, space systems, and imagineering.

  


**The Role**


**CSMC is seeking a Geophysicist** with experience in geophysics software development to join our engineering team. In this role, you'll play a pivotal part in enhancing our quantum remote sensor technology by developing sophisticated inversion algorithms and processing diverse geophysical datasets. This is an opportunity to contribute to real\-world impact in resource exploration, working in a collaborative environment that blends geophysics, AI, and quantum innovation.

  



The selected candidate will work closely with a broad array of engineers, scientists, and several of the most experienced space professionals in Canada.

  


**Key Responsibilities**


* Collaborate on the development of a joint gravity inversion algorithm, ideally incorporating AI/ML techniques, to integrate and interpret multi\-sensor data for subsurface modeling.
* Clean, process, and feed in geophysical datasets including gravity, LiDAR, magnetics, seismics, and other relevant sources to generate high\-resolution 3D subsurface density maps.
* Identify and characterize minerals and resources of interest (e.g., ores) through data analysis and algorithm outputs, supporting mining exploration applications.
* Work closely with quantum sensor engineers and data scientists to refine algorithms, validate models against field data, and optimize for real\-time or near\-real\-time processing.
* Conduct simulations, testing, and iterative improvements to ensure algorithm robustness and accuracy in diverse geological environments.
* Contribute to research papers, patents, or presentations on geophysical inversion methods and quantum sensing applications.
* Stay abreast of emerging trends in AI/ML for geophysics and subsurface imaging to inform ongoing development.

  


**Required Qualifications**


* Advanced degree (MSc or PhD) in Geophysics, Earth Sciences, Physics, or related field.
* Proven experience in geophysical data processing and inversion techniques, particularly gravity and multi\-sensor joint inversions.
* Strong software development skills, with proficiency in programming languages such as Python, MATLAB, or similar, and experience in GIS platforms and geophysical software tools (e.g., Geosoft, Oasis Montaj, or open\-source alternatives like SimPEG).
* Hands\-on experience with data cleaning, integration, and visualization of geophysical datasets (e.g., gravity, magnetics, seismics, LiDAR).
* Familiarity with 3D subsurface modeling and density mapping for resource identification in mining contexts.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and the ability to work in a multidisciplinary team.
* **Ability to** **operate** **in a fast\-paced, mission\-driven, and collaborative environment.**

  


**Preferred Skills**


* Experience with AI/ML frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch) applied to geophysical problems, such as inversion algorithms or predictive modeling.
* Experience with quantum sensing and/or remote sensing technologies.
* Background in mining geophysics, including mineral exploration or resource assessment, or field experience.
* Proficiency in handling large datasets and using cloud\-based computing for geophysical simulations.
* Strong communication skills for presenting technical findings to non\-experts.

  


**Why Join?**


* The chance to help shape the future of energy, space, and defence in Canada
* A collaborative, mission\-driven culture with a flat hierarchy and room for rapid growth
* Competitive compensation, benefits, and equity participation in a high\-growth startup

  



The candidate must be a highly motivated self\-starter, capable of working through complex issues to solve problems that are not off the shelf. They should be capable of moving through setbacks and finding ways to persevere.


**How To Apply**

  


**Submit your resume and a brief cover letter via our** **career** **portal outlining your experience and motivation for joining CSMC.**

  



We have an affinity for diverse people and thinkers with unique perspectives and life experience. CSMC is an equal opportunity employer supporting diversity and inclusion.



Must be eligible to work in Canada, and able to attain appropriate security clearances requisite with a defence, aerospace \& nuclear company of this type, and commensurate engineering position. Candidates will be subject to background checks.

Are you passionate about developing machine learning (ML) and Generative AI (GenAI) solutions? Amazon has been investing in research and application of ML for decades. We are looking for people who can leverage their machine learning and Generative AI expertise to solve various business problems for our customers.  

  

AWS Professional Services helps AWS customers accelerate the use of ML and GenAI to solve business and operational challenges and drive innovation within their organisations. If you have experience building ML or GenAI solutions, we encourage you to join us. We are constantly innovating at AWS, and look forward to working with great teammates and helping our customers together.  

  

Senior AI/ML Consultants understand customer business issues, analyse them, and summarise solutions. They build these solutions, using ML, GenAI and related AWS ML services as core component to solve the customer issues. They also work with their teammates such as AI/ML Engineers and Application Developers to bring these solutions to a production ready level. They are passionate about setting innovative goals and providing technical solutions to achieve them.  

  

You will be supporting Canadian Public Sector projects in this role.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Comprendre avec précision les enjeux d'affaires et les besoins du client, structurer les problématiques et les formaliser sous forme d'exigences métier.  

Identifier les exigences techniques nécessaires à la concrétisation de ces exigences d'affaires et sélectionner les services et algorithmes d'IA/ML les plus pertinents. De plus, vous collaborerez avec des experts issus de domaines techniques connexes pour concevoir et valider des solutions ML, tout en contribuant à l'élaboration d'une architecture intégrant les services AWS requis pour atteindre les objectifs du client.  

Accompagner notre client dans le développement de projets ML et GenAI, de la phase initiale à la finalisation : apporter un soutien technico\-commercial, réaliser des analyses exploratoires de données, concevoir et valider des solutions ML et/ou GenAI, déployer les solutions validées sur l'infrastructure sous\-jacente et assurer la formation des équipes clientes.  

Collaborer avec des ingénieurs ML, des architectes Cloud et des développeurs d'applications pour créer une solution ML ou GenAI prête pour la mise en production.  

Pour mener à bien ces missions, vous utiliserez un large éventail d'outils informatiques, incluant les services AWS (tels qu'Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Amazon AgentCore), Git et Docker, ainsi que divers frameworks ML et GenAI (tels que Strands\-Agents, PyTorch, Transformers, etc.).  

\-  

Accurately understand the customer's business challenges and needs, structure the problems, and organise them as business requirements.  

Extract the IT requirements necessary to realise the business requirements and select candidate AI/ML services and algorithms. In addition, you will work with specialist roles in related technical fields to build and verify ML solutions, as wellas help develop an architecture that combines the necessary AWS services for achieving the customer's goals.  

Assist our customer on developing ML and GenAI projects from start to finish, providing technical sales support, conducting exploratory data analysis, building and validating ML and/or GenAI solutions, deploying validated solutions on their supporting infrastructure, and providing training to our customers.  

Collaborate with ML Engineers Cloud Architect and Application Developer to build a production ready ML or GenAI solution  

To support the above, you will work with a wide range of IT tools, including AWS services (e.g. Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Sagemaker, Amazon AgentCore), Git and Docker, as well as with a range on Ml and GenAI framework such as Strands\-Agents, pytorch, transformers, etc.

title: AI Specialist
description:
Nutrien is a leading provider of crop inputs and services, and our business results make a positive impact on the world. Our purpose, *Feeding the Future*, is the reason we come to work each day. We’re guided by our culture of care and our core values: *We put safety first. We act with integrity. We are stronger together. We deliver with excellence.*

  

Through the collective expertise of our nearly 26,000 employees, we operate a world\-class network of production, distribution, and ag retail facilities. We efficiently serve growers' needs and strive to provide a more profitable, sustainable, and secure future for all stakeholders. Help us raise the expectation of what an agriculture company can be and grow your career with Nutrien.

  



We are seeking a hands\-on, creative AI/Data Specialist who thrives at the intersection of data, experimentation, and storytelling. In this role, you’ll play a key part in designing, building, and delivering AI/ML prototypes and data\-driven insights that shape enterprise innovation.

  

You will work closely with architects, engineers, and business stakeholders to rapidly turn ideas into tangible proofs of concepts blending data analysis, visualization, and AI experimentation into compelling stories that influence decision\-making.

**What You'll Do:**
-------------------

 **AI / ML \& Data Prototyping**

  

* Collaborate with AI architects and data scientists to design and build prototypes, models, and proof\-of\-concept AI solutions
* Explore and experiment with LLMs, embeddings, and ML models using platforms such as OpenAI, Hugging Face, or Azure OpenAI
* Support data preparation, feature engineering, and basic model training or fine tuning
* Contribute to retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) or agentic AI pilots under senior guidance
* Help operationalize small\-scale experiments and evaluate their effectiveness

 **Visualization \& Storytelling**

  

* Create interactive dashboards and visualization prototypes to showcase insights and model results using tools like Power BI, Tableau, Streamlit, or Plotly Dash
* Translate complex analytical outputs into clear, visually engaging narratives for business stakeholders
* Build storyboards and data narratives that communicate how AI and data can drive value in specific business processes
* Support senior AI leaders in preparing executive\-level presentations and demo assets for key initiatives

 **Data Handling \& Integration**

  

* Work with structured and unstructured datasets from multiple sources, ensuring data cleanliness and readiness for AI experimentation
* Utilize SQL, Python (Pandas, NumPy), or cloud data tools to extract and transform data for analysis and visualization
* Document prototype processes, data flows, and results to enable scaling and reusability

 **Collaboration \& Continuous Learning**

  

* Collaborate with business SMEs, data engineers, and designers to understand requirements and co\-create prototypes
* Stay current on emerging tools in GenAI, visualization, and MLOps and share learnings with the broader team
* Embrace an agile, iterative approach to experimentation, moving quickly from idea to working demo
**What You'll Bring:**
----------------------

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, or related field
* 2–5 years of hands\-on experience in data analysis, ML prototyping, or AI solution development
* Proficiency in Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit\-learn, Matplotlib, or Plotly)
* Experience with data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, or Streamlit)
* Working knowledge of LLM APIs (eg, OpenAI, Anthropic, Hugging Face) and basic prompt engineering
* Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP for running small AI or data workloads
* Strong communication skills with the ability to craft data\-driven stories and visual presentations

 **Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Experience supporting GenAI or ML experiments in a lab or enterprise environment
* Familiarity with vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma) and simple RAG setup
* Exposure to business process data (finance, supply chain, HR, or operations) and an understanding of how AI can enhance workflows
* Enthusiasm for rapid prototyping, design thinking, and visual storytelling
 **Ready to make an impact with us? Apply today!**

  

The estimated salary that Indeed, Glassdoor and LinkedIn lists does not represent Nutrien's compensation structure. Nutrien is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics.

  

This job will remain posted until filled. In accordance with Nutrien policies, you will be required to undergo a background check, and may be required to undergo a substance test. While we appreciate all applications we receive, only candidates under consideration will be contacted. Applicants must meet minimum age requirements, as permitted by law.

  



Our Recruitment Process: Application \> Resume Review \> Pre\-screen/Interview \> Offer \> Pre\-Employment Conditions \> Welcome to Nutrien

 **To stay connected to us and for the latest job postings and news, follow us on:** LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram.

description:
**Job Number: R0238003**
 Data Scientist, Mid
   

  

**The Opportunity** 
**:**
 The proliferation of technology like IoT, machine learning, and artificial intelligence means that critical data is often locked away in complex, siloed systems. As a Data Scientist, you know that the real challenge isn't just organizing data, but transforming it into a dynamic, interactive foundation for decision\-making. We need a versatile problem\-solver like you to help build end\-to\-end solutions with platforms such as Palantir Foundry, Databricks, and AWS, enabling our clients to tackle missions from fraud detection to cancer research.
   

  

 As a Data Scientist, you will be a key contributor to the technical solution. This role offers a unique opportunity to grow your skills across data engineering, data science, and front\-end development. Working under the guidance of senior engineers, you’ll help develop and deploy the data pipelines that organize and make disparate data meaningful. You will collaborate with your team and end\-users to understand their requirements, then use that insight to help implement the data ontology, support analyses, and configure user\-facing applications and workflows. Your goal is to be a vital part of the team closing the gap between raw data and operational impact.
   

  

 You will be embedded with clients, working in a fast\-paced, agile environment where you take on increasing responsibility for key components of the solution. You'll learn to move fluidly between writing data transformations, exploring data for key insights, and configuring front\-end modules to deliver a seamless user experience. You'll quickly develop a strong understanding of the client's mission as you help your team turn their most complex data challenges into intuitive, powerful software solutions.
   

  

 Work with us as we use data science for good.
   

  

 Join us. The world can’t wait.
   

  

**You Have:** 
  

  

* 2\+ years of experience utilizing programming languages, including C\+\+, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, or Python
* 2\+ years of experience developing and maintaining scalable data stores that supply data in forms needed for business analysis
* Experience creating solutions within a collaborative, cross\-functional team
* Experience developing scripts and programs for converting various types of data into usable formats, and supporting the project team to scale, monitor, and operate data platforms
* Secret clearance
* Bachelor's degree and 1\+ years of experience with data engineering, including application or software development in a professional environment, or 3\+ years of experience with data engineering, including application or software development in a professional environment, in lieu of a degree


**Nice If You Have:** 
  

  

* Experience in application development utilizing SQL
* Experience with Palantir Foundry
* Experience working with Maven Smart Systems
* Experience working with Node.js and languages that transpile to JavaScript
* Experience with distributed data and computing tools such as Spark, Databricks, Hadoop, Hive, AWS EMR, or Kafka
* Experience working on real\-time data and streaming applications
* Experience with data warehousing, including AWS Redshift, BigQuery, or Snowflake
* Experience with advanced automation of software delivery, including Infrastructure as Code such as Terraform or AWS CloudFormation, containerization such as Docker, and orchestration such as Kubernetes or EKS, aligned to DevSecOps practices


**Clearance:**
 Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; Secret clearance is required.
   

  

**Compensation**
 At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well\-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work\-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full\-time and part\-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.
   

  

 Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract\-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $77,500\.00 to $176,000\.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

 As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

They generate and test hypotheses and analyze and interpret the results of product experiments. Create data visualizations, dashboards, and reports to communicate findings. title: Head of Product - AI LAB
description:
Head of Product \- AI LAB \| DatacomOur Why
Datacom works with organisations and communities across Australia and New Zealand to make a difference in people's lives and help organisations use the power of tech to make it all happen.


About the Role
We're looking for a **Head of Product** for our **AI LAB** who will work closely with the **Head of the AI LAB** and who is equal parts product genius, builder, and relationship wrangler. This is not a role for someone who wants to make pretty widgets and get stuck in a triple diamond design mode. This is a senior, visible, and genuinely challenging role at the heart of one of ANZ's largest technology companies.


You'll be the person who makes AI real at Datacom — for our clients, our teams, and our business. That means bringing people with you, building products that actually sell, and knowing enough about the technology to call a bad idea what it is.


If you thrive in complexity, love people as much as you love technology, and want to build something that matters — read on.


What You'll Do
Product \& Go\-To\-Market — Build Things That Actually Sell
There's no shortage of AI Ideas at Datacom. What we need is someone who can take the best of those ideas and turn them into products that win in the market — products that our own teams want to put into projects for our external customers as well as for our internal work.

**Building Commercial AI Products**

* Lead the development of Datacom's AI product portfolio — from the first whiteboard session through to commercial launch and iteration
* Work closely with Product, Engineering, and Design to shape offerings that are genuinely differentiated — not just features dressed up as products
* Define clear value propositions that resonate with buyers — focused on outcomes, not technology for technology's sake
* Build the business case rigour that gives the organisation confidence to invest — and the commercial model that makes it worth investing in

**Winning in the Market**

* Deeply understand the ANZ AI market — where it is now, where it's going, and where Datacom has a genuine right to win
* Shape go\-to\-market strategies that are realistic, targeted, and built on customer insight rather than internal assumption
* Identify the verticals — Government, Health, Financial Services, Retail — where Datacom's AI products will land hardest and fastest
* Stay close to the competitive landscape and ensure Datacom's positioning is sharp, honest, and compelling

**Making Datacom Teams Love What You Build**

* Partner closely with our Teams to ensure AI products are easy to understand, easy to position, and easy to sell
* Create the collateral, the narratives, and the proof points that gives teams genuine confidence in the field
* Be accessible — the kind of product leader who shows up to client conversations, supports bids, and helps close deals
* Gather post\-sale and post\-launch feedback relentlessly — and use it to make things better


AI Technology — Know Enough to Matter
You don't need to be the best data scientist in the room. But you do need to be the person who knows when something is genuinely promising and when someone is selling you a dream. In this role, you'll be surrounded by people who live and breathe AI technology — and by senior stakeholders who will expect you to hold your own in every conversation.

**Technology Credibility**

* Maintain a deep enough understanding of AI/ML, LLMs, foundation models, and agentic systems to make sound technology judgements
* Know how to spot a bad idea — whether it's an overhyped vendor pitch, an architecture that won't scale, or an automation play that solves the wrong problem
* Engage authentically with Datacom's technical AI teams — earning their respect not through authority, but through genuine understanding and intellectual curiosity
* Be the person who asks the right questions in a technical discussion and knows what to do with the answers

**Agentic AI \& Automation**

* Understand the shift happening right now toward agentic AI — multi\-agent systems, autonomous workflows, and AI that doesn't just respond but acts
* Drive Datacom's capability in intelligent automation — including document processing, workflow automation, conversational AI, and process intelligence
* Oversee the integration of LLMs, RAG pipelines, and agentic frameworks (AutoGen, LangChain, CrewAI) into Datacom products and client solutions
* Ensure Datacom's AI technology choices are sound, scalable, secure, and commercially sensible

**Staying Current — For Real**

* This is a field that moves fast. Really fast. You'll need to invest the time to stay genuinely current — not just across headlines, but across the technology, the vendors, the research, and the use cases
* Be the person in the room who has already read the paper, tried the tool, and formed a view — not the one catching up
* Build a culture of continuous AI learning across Datacom — because your credibility as Head of AI LAB depends partly on the capability of the team and organisation around you


What You'll Bring* Senior leadership experience in AI, technology, or a related field — with the scars to prove it
* Extensive Product Knowledge in a corporate or enterprise scaled environment \- it is fine to have come through an entrepreneurial pathway BUT we need you to have that enterprise product understanding and experience in tandem.
* **A natural relationship builder** — someone who can work a room, navigate resistance, and build trust across every level of a large organisation
* **Real commercial instincts** — you understand what makes a product succeed, how to take it to market, and what sales teams need to win
* **Genuine technical credibility in AI** — not necessarily the deepest technical expert, but someone who has done the work to understand the technology and keeps doing it
* Comfort presenting and influencing at General Manager, Executive, and Leader level — clear, confident, and able to simplify without dumbing down
* Experience in complex, matrixed organisations where you've had to lead through influence rather than authority
* A bias for action — someone who moves things forward, makes decisions with imperfect information, and learns fast


Why Datacom?
At Datacom we value our people and provide a collaborative environment that supports career development and growth.


We offer:

* Flexible \& hybrid working arrangements
* Competitive salary \+ company benefits
* A genuinely senior platform to shape AI across one of ANZ's largest tech companies
* The complexity, scale, and ambiguity that makes a role like this worth doing
* A diverse and inclusive culture where different perspectives are not just welcomed — they're needed
* Real career development and the support to keep growing

Diversity counts at E.ON. We welcome all people and believe that differences make us stronger. Become part of our inclusive and diverse corporate culture!

* Monitor live strategy performance, detect drift or anomalies, and implement rapid feedback loops for continuous improvement.
* Communicate results clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders, translate complex model outputs into trading insights and strategic recommendations.
* Stay current with developments, and state\-of\-the\-art methods in ML/optimisation relevant to energy trading.

* MSc or PhD in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, Operations Research, or a related quantitative field.
* 10\+ years of professional experience applying data science or quantitative modelling in an energy trading, energy tech, or commodity trading environment.
* Proven track record of developing and deploying IT/data\-driven solutions that directly support trading decisions or automated dispatch using MLOps tooling and CI/CD for model deployment
* Deep understanding of European electricity markets (EPEX, Nord Pool, or equivalent) including day\-ahead, intraday continuous, and balancing mechanisms.
* Excellent programming skills in Python (pandas, NumPy, scikit\-learn, LightGBM/XGBoost, or similar); SQL and cloud\-based data platforms.
* Experience with reinforcement learning, Bayesian methods, or time\-series deep learning (LSTMs, Transformers) in a trading context.
